PLEASE READ BEFORE ARRIVAL

Rules & Regulations

Help us keep the farewell safe, classy, and memorable for everyone.

01 · Pass is compulsory

  • A valid event pass is compulsory for entry.
  • Keep your pass ready for verification at the entrance.
  • Entry is allowed only after organiser/volunteer verification.
  • Do not duplicate, transfer, or misuse your pass.

02 · No alcohol or smoking

  • Alcohol is strictly prohibited for attendees at this school event.
  • Smoking, vaping, and tobacco products are not allowed.
  • Illegal substances and intoxicants are strictly prohibited.
  • Rule violations may lead to refusal of entry or removal.

03 · Behaviour & safety

  • Respect fellow attendees, organisers, staff, and venue property.
  • Harassment, fighting, abusive behaviour, or property damage will not be tolerated.
  • Follow all instructions from the event team and venue staff.
  • Dangerous, sharp, or prohibited items are not allowed.

04 · Entry & responsibility

  • Arrive within the timing announced by the organisers.
  • Do not enter restricted areas; follow venue guidance.
  • Keep your belongings safe; attendees are responsible for personal items.
  • Organisers may refuse entry for rule violations or safety concerns.

Any additional instructions shared by the organising team before the event will also apply.
